name: Tawazun Council for Defence Enablement
via: Tawazun Council's own 'who we are': 'an independent government entity that works closely with the Ministry of Defense and security agencies in the United Arab Emirates' (claim tawazun-council-uae-government-entity)
note: Established in 1992 as the UAE Offset Group, renamed Tawazun Council in 2022 (tawazun.gov.ae about page); its site lists the UAE Ministry of Defence and Ministry of Interior as strategic partners. Al Ain FC partnership announced 25 Jun 2025 (training jerseys, stadium gate naming) and renewed 5 Aug 2026.
